description: Header file defining classes and structures for managing EGL windows and configurations in ANGLE project, including EGL context, surface, display initialization, and platform-specific parameters.

classes.name: ConfigParameters
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for EGL context and surface setup, including color depth, multisampling, and extension options.

classes.name: GLWindowBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for an OpenGL window, managing context creation, swapping, and error checking.

classes.name: EGLWindow
classes.description: Derived class implementing EGL-specific window management, including display, surface, and context initialization and destruction.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a GLWindowBase or EGLWindow instance.

methods.name: initializeGL
methods.description: Initializes the OpenGL context with specified platform parameters and configuration.

methods.name: isGLInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the OpenGL context has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if there has been an error in the OpenGL context.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for buffer swapping.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates an EGL context with optional sharing.

methods.name: CheckExtensionExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific EGL extension exists in the list of all extensions.
